record.original_question: Develop a satisfactory way to determine or sharply estimate the minimum distances of the duals of primitive BCH codes, since the chapter reports that this approximation problem remained open.

evidence.quote: Generally the numerical results obtained in this way show that the approximation of the minimum distance of the duals of primitive BCH codes remains an open problem.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $q$ be a prime power, $m\ge 2$ an integer, and set $n=q^m-1$. Let $\alpha$ be a primitive element of $\mathbb{F}_{q^m}$. For a designed distance $\delta$ with $2\le \delta\le n$, the primitive narrow-sense BCH code $\mathcal{C}(q,m,\delta)$ over $\mathbb{F}_q$ of length $n$ is the cyclic code whose generator polynomial is the least-degree monic polynomial in $\mathbb{F}_q[x]$ having $\alpha,\alpha^2,\dots,\alpha^{\delta-1}$ as roots. Its (Euclidean) dual code $\mathcal{C}(q,m,\delta)^{\perp}$ is the set of all vectors in $\mathbb{F}_q^n$ orthogonal to every codeword of $\mathcal{C}(q,m,\delta)$ under the standard inner product.

Develop a general method that either determines exactly, or yields sharp lower and upper bounds for, the minimum Hamming distance $d(\mathcal{C}(q,m,\delta)^{\perp})$ as a function of $q$, $m$, and $\delta$, valid uniformly across the full range of parameters.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of sharply estimating the minimum distance of duals of primitive BCH codes remains an active research area. Partial progress includes Carlitz–Uchiyama-type bounds and the multiplier technique of Huffman–Pless, with recent improvements in 2024 (IEEE Trans. Inform. Theory) providing better lower bounds for primitive narrow-sense BCH codes. However, a fully satisfactory general determination or sharp estimate across all parameters has not been established.

status_evidence.title: Improved Lower Bounds on the Minimum Distances of the Dual Codes of Primitive Narrow-Sense BCH Codes
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work uses the multiplier technique to investigate lower bounds on minimum distances of dual codes of primitive narrow-sense BCH codes.
status_evidence.claim: Research continues to improve lower bounds; no general sharp determination is given.

status_evidence.title: Bounds on the minimum distance of the duals of BCH codes (Augot et al.)
status_evidence.snippet: Estimates on the minimum distance of duals of BCH codes derived via specific theorems.
status_evidence.claim: Partial bounds exist but the problem is not fully resolved.

status_evidence.title: On the Minimum Distances of Some Families of BCH Codes
status_evidence.snippet: True minimum distance of only a small number of families of BCH codes is known.
status_evidence.claim: Determining true minimum distances (including duals) remains open in general.
